mapper.sql: CASE WHEN CURDATE() < DATE(p.project_recruit_start_dt) THEN 'SCHEDULED' WHEN CURDATE() > DATE(p.project_recruit_end_dt) THEN 'CLOSED' ELSE 'RECRUITING' END
FROM TBL_PROJECT_M p LEFT JOIN TBL_COMPANY_S c ON c.company_sq = p.company_sq LEFT JOIN TBL_USER_M u ON u.user_sq = c.user_sq
mapper.select:
SELECT p.project_sq AS projectSq, p.project_ttl AS projectTtl, p.company_sq AS companySq, c.company_nm AS companyNm, u.user_sq AS userSq, u.user_id AS userId, p.project_recruit_start_dt AS recruitStartDt, p.project_recruit_end_dt AS recruitEndDt, p.project_start_dt AS projectStartDt, p.project_end_dt AS projectEndDt, AS recruitStatus, p.project_salary AS projectSalary, p.project_salary_negotiable_yn AS salaryNegotiableYn, p.project_description_txt AS descriptionTxt, p.project_preference_txt AS preferenceTxt, a.address AS address, a.detail_address AS detailAddress, p.project_view_cnt AS viewCnt, p.project_scrap_cnt AS scrapCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_PROJECT_APPLICATION_H ap WHERE ap.project_sq = p.project_sq) AS applicationCnt, p.project_is_deleted_yn AS isDeletedYn, p.project_created_at_dtm AS createdAt, p.project_modified_at_dtm AS modifiedAt
LEFT JOIN TBL_ADDRESS_S a ON a.address_sq = p.address_sq WHERE p.project_sq = #{projectSq}
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_PROJECT_M SET project_is_deleted_yn = 'Y''N', project_modified_at_dtm = NOW() WHERE project_sq = #{projectSq}
